corpus-01.translation: Teacher, I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.

corpus-03.translation: No, it's good to keep a sense of mystery.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不谈恋爱/不处对象”，译成“No”丢失了这层含义，观众无法理解说话人拒绝的是什么。

context-01.translation: Don't worry, I've memorized it thoroughly.

corpus-02.translation: That head tilt was him sneaking a peek at the lyrics!

name-01.translation: Lin Xiao, why did you come so early today?

slang-01.translation: That move was too impressive—I completely lost it.

errors.note: “太秀了”是网络口语，意为“太厉害/太秀”，译成“too impressive”偏书面且“too”带负面意味，语气和含义都有偏差。
“裂开”是网络用语，表示崩溃、无语或震惊，而“lost it”多指失控发怒或大笑，语义偏移。

corpus-06.translation: It seems to be true. I even came across leaked videos from his concert.

errors.note: “路透视频”指粉丝/路人拍摄的现场片段，并非“泄露的视频”，leaked 改变了含义。
过于直译生硬，口语字幕中更自然的说法是“That's so sudden?”或“So sudden?”作为独立感叹略显不自然，但意思可理解。

corpus-08.translation: Besides, his honest and down-to-earth vibe makes him so approachable. You're not losing out at all this time—who knows, you might even score a free meal with that face.

corpus-07.translation: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?

corpus-09.translation: Should this souvenir be thrown away?

corpus-05.translation: Hahaha, it's just too abstract. Who even gets this question?

errors.note: 原文“就是哈哈哈太抽象了”是口语化感叹，译文用“it's just too abstract”略显书面，且“just”位置使语气稍显生硬，不够像字幕口语。
“够抽象的”是反讽，指想法离谱/莫名其妙，译文却译成“足够抽象”，丢失了这层贬义，意思明显偏差。
直译生硬，不像口语字幕，未体现原文调侃语气。

corpus-12.translation: So short, have you hit a creative block?

corpus-11.translation: Alright, I'll wait until I return to the country to deal with these toxic motivational posts.

errors.span: I'll wait until I return to the country
errors.note: “等我回国处理”是“等我回国后再处理这些毒鸡汤”，译文误将“等”理解为“等待回国”，改变了语义，应为“I'll deal with these... once I'm back in the country”。
“毒鸡汤”指有害的励志/心灵鸡汤文，译法基本达意但偏直译，可更自然如“toxic inspirational posts”。

corpus-14.translation: Whose proposal is better, yours or your colleague's PPT?

errors.note: 原文“方案”指方案/计划，译成 proposal（提案）改变了所指，且与“PPT”并列时语义不对等。
原文是“你的方案”与“同事的PPT”对比，译文把“yours”理解为“你的PPT”，漏掉了“方案”，对比对象错位。

corpus-17.translation: No way. These days, even love comes with a price tag.

corpus-16.translation: I wish you'd told me earlier. No wonder you post sunrises on your Moments every day.

corpus-15.translation: Just look at that pretentious expression—you know there's something fishy going on. That kind of deadpan nonsense is the most comedic.

errors.note: “最有喜剧效果”译成“the most comedic”生硬、不像口语字幕，宜用“the funniest”或“comedy gold”之类更自然的表达。

corpus-19.translation: Look, the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.

corpus-18.translation: No thanks, go play by yourself.

errors.note: “不处”是拒绝处对象/交往，不是“不用谢/谢谢不用”，译成 No thanks 把拒绝交往误译成客套推辞，意思明显偏差。

corpus-21.translation: On the subway, I ran into a guy who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole way.

corpus-22.translation: Last night I stayed up late watching your livestream and laughed until my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.translation: In a rush to leave, I accidentally brought the dishcloth to the office instead of a towel.

corpus-27.translation: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-20.translation: Hakimi north and south mung beans, I'm holding back internal injuries at my workstation.

errors.note: “哈基米”是网络流行语（源自日语“はちみ”，常指可爱小动物/梗词），音译成“Hakimi”会被误读为足球运动员阿什拉夫·哈基米，属专名误用。
“南北绿豆”是网络梗/无实义谐音串，直译为南北方向的绿豆，语义被曲解且生硬。
“憋出内伤”是夸张口语，直译 internal injuries 显得生硬，不像字幕口语。

corpus-28.translation: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.

corpus-24.translation: No way, the melon's too big to bite into.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不处对象/不谈恋爱”，译成“No way”改变了意思，属于误译。

errors.span: the melon's too big to bite into
errors.note: “瓜太大了啃不动”是网络俚语，指八卦信息量太大难以消化，直译为“瓜太大咬不动”丢失了比喻义，观众会误解为真的在说西瓜。

corpus-29.translation: Treadmill, elliptical, and spin bike—which is more suitable for obese people who want to lose fat?

errors.note: “大体重”指体重较大/超重人群，译为“obese”（肥胖）语义过强，属于医学诊断用语，与原文程度不完全对应。

corpus-38.translation: I was scrolling through videos and saw the extra-large jianbing guozi made by an auntie in Shandong, and suddenly I got curious: is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the country?

corpus-34.translation: In work, I'm always interrupted by various messages and find it hard to focus on tasks. Are there any methods to improve efficiency?

corpus-32.translation: I'm already running a fever, so please, aunties, let me off the hook.

errors.note: “放过我”在此语境指请求大妈们别再纠缠/催婚催生等，而“let me off the hook”意为免除责任或惩罚，语义有偏差。

corpus-39.translation: Its high score of 9.4 on Douban also proves its quality.

corpus-31.translation: Oh man, I can't take it, I'll be laughing about this experience for a year. Who doesn't have some embarrassing period pad purchase story, right?

errors.span: Oh man, I can't take it
errors.note: “I can't take it”在英语里多表示受不了/无法忍受，用来对应“我不行了（笑到不行）”语气略偏，口语字幕里用“I can't”或“I'm dying”更自然。
“period pad purchase story”偏书面、生硬，口语字幕更常说“buying pads”或“pad-buying story”。

corpus-33.translation: Watching post-00s chat using Martian language.

errors.note: “火星文”指网络俚语/网络黑话，并非字面意义上的火星语言，直译会误导观众。
作为字幕片段，缺少冠词/限定词，读起来生硬，例如应为“Watching post-00s chatting”或“Watching the post-00s chat”。

corpus-40.translation: I can't take it anymore, happiness came too suddenly.

errors.note: “我不行了”在此语境中是表达被幸福冲击得招架不住，而非“再也受不了了”，译文语气偏负面，容易误导观众。
直译生硬，字幕口语中更自然的说法如“this is so sudden”或“happiness came out of nowhere”。

corpus-42.translation: Hahaha I can't even, the netizens this time are truly too talented.

errors.note: “I can't even”是网络流行语，与“我不行了”的感叹语气不完全对应，略显生硬。
“这届网友”是网络流行说法，直译为“the netizens this time”不够自然，建议用“this batch of netizens”或“netizens these days”。

corpus-45.translation: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team is called Xiaochao Team, right? I remember it all!

corpus-41.translation: Others: A white-browed tiger with upturned eyes. Me: A Qiaolezi ice cream bar.

errors.span: A white-browed tiger with upturned eyes
errors.note: “吊睛”指眼睛上吊/斜吊的老虎眼型，译成“upturned eyes”偏字面，尚可理解但不够准确自然。
“巧乐兹”是品牌名，音译“Qiaolezi”可接受，但英文观众难以理解，宜保留品牌或加注。

corpus-44.translation: I can't take it anymore. Working overtime has numbed me completely.

corpus-47.translation: Can you stop dragging me into playing games?

errors.note: “drag someone into doing”偏书面/生硬，口语字幕中“dragging me to play games”或“making me play games”更自然。

corpus-48.translation: I can't handle this, it's way too cute!

ctx-01.translation: Don't worry, I've memorized it thoroughly.

corpus-49.translation: I can't take it anymore, I know everything, working myself to baldness.

errors.note: “肝到秃头”是网络口语，指熬夜/拼命到掉头发；直译成“working myself to baldness”生硬不自然，不像字幕口语，建议如“working myself bald”或“grinding till I go bald”。

ctx-02.translation: Said he won't be back for dinner tonight.

errors.note: 原文“我妈”指说话人的母亲（女性），译文用“he”把主语性别弄错，观众会得到错误信息。

ctx-c02.translation: Keep it dry, or we'll have to replace it again.

ctx-c05.translation: The power of six wallets, your family must have a mine at home.

errors.span: your family must have a mine at home
errors.note: “家里有矿”是中文网络俚语，意为非常有钱；直译成“have a mine at home”生硬且不自然，英文观众可能无法领会其俚语含义。

ctx-c38.translation: Sometimes the gameplay is so terrifyingly good that the audience suspects cheating—they just spam "666" and don't even bother booing.

errors.note: 原文指球员的投篮手感/状态，不是游戏玩法，gameplay 会误导观众以为是电子游戏。
原文“手感太恐怖”是口语化夸张，译成 terrifyingly good 略显生硬，可用更自然的说法如 insanely hot。

m-001.translation: Let me tell you a secret: search for the manager and keep a Douyin virtual pet for fun.

errors.note: “主理人”在此语境中应指抖音上的账号/博主（如“搜索主理人”指搜索某类账号），译成“the manager”会让观众误以为是搜索一位经理，意思明显偏差。
“养只……电子宠物”用“keep a virtual pet”偏书面，字幕口语中更自然的是“raise/get yourself a Douyin virtual pet”，但不影响理解。

m-004.translation: When playing poker, some people always like to quote movie lines.

m-002.translation: It is recommended to take your parents to a physical store to try out the system smoothness. For memory, the 12+256G version is suggested.

errors.note: “内存”指运行内存/RAM，译为“memory”易与存储混淆，宜用“RAM”或“memory (RAM)”。
被动语态生硬，字幕口语中更自然的是“we suggest the 12+256G version”或“go for the 12+256G version”。

ctx-c57.translation: LMAO, add a bit to that last sentence, it got the boss all heated up. When introverts explode, they really go hard.

errors.span: add a bit to that last sentence
errors.note: 原文“最后那句加点啊”是博主对视频/内容提出的建议（最后那句要加/补点东西），译文却译成“给最后那句话加点内容”，且与后文“把老板整红温”的因果关系被割裂，意思有偏差。

errors.span: it got the boss all heated up
errors.note: “整红温”是网络用语，指把老板惹到脸红/破防，译文“heated up”偏字面，语气和网络梗味有所流失，但大意可理解。

errors.span: When introverts explode, they really go hard
errors.note: “社恐人爆发起来是真的猛”译得基本达意，但“explode/go hard”偏夸张书面，作为字幕口语略生硬。

m-005.translation: Seeing a little dog by the roadside wagging its tail at me.

errors.span: Seeing a little dog by the roadside wagging its tail at me.
errors.note: 这是片段而非完整句子，缺少主句，作为字幕显得悬空、不完整。

m-006.translation: You know what? Our school cafeteria is actually free today.

errors.note: 原文“今天居然免费”指今天这顿饭/活动免费，译文说食堂本身“免费”，意思偏差，易误导观众。

m-003.translation: May I ask, did you just come out of the newbie village?

errors.span: May I ask, did you just come out of the newbie village?
errors.note: “May I ask”过于正式生硬，不符合字幕口语语气；“newbie village”是游戏术语的直译，英文观众更常说“starter village/area”，但整体可理解。

m-008.translation: No obligation to tell you, it's my little secret.

m-009.translation: Can playing abstract also make you a master? Are you the plagiarism police?

errors.note: “玩抽象”是网络用语，指做抽象/荒诞搞笑的内容，译成“playing abstract”字面直译，英语观众无法理解其含义。
原文“也能”在此处表反问/质疑语气，译文用“also”显得像陈述递进，语气略有偏差。

m-010.translation: Recently I've noticed that many of my friends are into stand-up comedy, and even my parents have started watching it.

m-011.translation: I just found out my mom gave away my treasured figurines.

m-007.translation: Hahahaha, this mental image is so strong.

errors.span: this mental image is so strong
errors.note: “mental image is so strong”是直译，英语口语中不自然，通常说“I can picture it so vividly”或“such a strong image”。

m-014.translation: Last night while gaming, I realized that long-pressing this button triggers the ultimate move.

m-012.translation: This document must be finished reading today.

errors.note: “must be finished reading”搭配生硬，英语中更自然的说法是“must be read/finished by today”。
表达不够口语化、不像字幕用语，观众理解无碍但读起来别扭。

m-013.translation: Some people say I look especially pale, like I'm mixed-race.

m-015.translation: Bestie, I can't take it anymore. This gossip is too explosive.

m-016.translation: Remember to bring a lightweight large cloth bag to hold everything; a backpack is inconvenient on the beach.

m-017.translation: This streamer's story is way too absurd.

m-019.translation: I really can't take it anymore, my stomach is about to explode.

m-018.translation: The difficulty of this game is absolutely ridiculous.

errors.note: “very creative”是直译，口语中更自然、更像字幕的说法是“creative”或“so creative”；“very”在这里显得生硬。

m-022.translation: Li Zongheng's performance in this segment is absolutely amazing—he could take the big stage in no time.

m-023.translation: I wish you'd told me earlier. I'm going to make up the lesson right now.

m-020.translation: And that "so what, what can you do about it" stuff, it makes me want to crap. It's as brainwashing as a virus.

errors.span: so what, what can you do about it
errors.note: “又能怎”是反问语气（“那又能怎样”），译成“what can you do about it”偏向“你能做什么”，语气略有偏差，但大意可理解。

errors.span: It's as brainwashing as a virus
errors.note: “brainwashing”作形容词搭配“as...as”生硬不自然，英语中更常说“as addictive/catchy as a virus”，此处措辞不够地道。

m-026.translation: And now every time I just say, "Then just deal with it," letting him experience what it's like to have a grievance he can't voice.

m-024.translation: Everyone sitting here must be crying from anxiety by now!

errors.span: must be crying from anxiety by now
errors.note: “急哭”是夸张的口语说法，指着急/焦躁到极点，并非真的哭泣；“crying from anxiety”按字面理解为因焦虑而流泪，改变了原意。

errors.span: Everyone sitting here must be crying from anxiety by now!
errors.note: 语气过于书面、冗长，不像字幕口语；原文是带调侃意味的感叹句，译文显得生硬。

m-027.translation: What exactly do you mean by "yes-man"?

m-025.translation: Starting the tutorial at frame zero, huh? Skipping even the warm-up moves—this coach must be a former esports player.

errors.span: Starting the tutorial at frame zero
errors.note: “0帧教学”指教学从第0帧/一开局就开始，译文“at frame zero”字面直译，未传达“一上来就教学、毫无铺垫”的含义，意思有偏差。
原文“可还行”是调侃吐槽语气，译成“huh?”语气偏疑问，吐槽感不足，略不自然。

m-030.translation: This is not the same as what I ordered.

m-029.translation: You made me waste so much time.

m-031.translation: Haven't you noticed that he spins around on the red carpet at every major event?

m-032.translation: I've noticed that a guy has been marking my water bottle lately.

m-028.translation: Your pronunciation is so bizarrely catchy.

errors.note: “魔性”指发音怪异、洗脑或搞笑，而“catchy”意为好听易记，语义偏差明显，未能准确传达原意。

m-033.translation: Bro B acts out a real scene from his school days when he was listening attentively in class but suddenly got inexplicably angry.

errors.note: “b哥”是网络昵称/称呼，译作“Bro B”略显生硬且不一致，可考虑音译或保留“B”作为昵称。

errors.span: acts out a real scene from his school days when he was listening attentively in class but suddenly got inexplicably angry
errors.note: 整句偏书面、冗长，不像字幕口语，可拆分或简化以更自然。

m-035.translation: The PPT the teacher showed in class was way too funny.

m-037.translation: Let me show you all a special trick.

m-039.translation: I heard Nestle is going to make an independent film.

errors.note: “这群”指这群人/这个地方的这群人，译成“This group”生硬且指代偏差，应为“These people”或“This crowd”。
“没法待了”意为待不下去/无法忍受这个环境，译成“unbearable”修饰“group”改变了主语和含义。

m-038.translation: I suggest you still take a look at all of them, after all, last year's test takers also said 'it definitely won't be on the exam,' and that question ended up appearing in the end.

m-036.translation: When I watch funny videos, I hold back and don't dare laugh out loud.

m-040.translation: I can't take it, this looks way too much like it.

errors.span: this looks way too much like it
errors.note: “这也太像了吧”指两者相似度极高，译文“looks way too much like it”把“像”误解为“看起来像某物”，且“this…like it”指代混乱，意思有明显偏差。
“我不行了”在此为口语感叹，表示受不了/惊叹，译成“I can't take it”偏生硬，语气不够自然。

m-041.translation: That's too abstract. What kind of brand-new tactic is this?

m-044.translation: This is way funnier than a Spring Festival Gala sketch.

m-045.translation: I can't take it anymore. Waking people up in the middle of the night is really too much to handle.

m-048.translation: My blind date talked about her cat the entire time.

m-042.translation: Back in the day, I was full of vigor and ambition, playing my skill cards so well that wealth poured in from all directions. Now I've fallen so low as to be polishing shoes here.

errors.span: playing my skill cards so well that wealth poured in from all directions
errors.note: “skill cards”和“wealth poured in from all directions”过于直译，口语字幕中显得生硬，可更自然些。

errors.span: I've fallen so low as to be polishing shoes here
errors.note: “fallen so low as to be polishing”略显书面/生硬，字幕口语可用“ended up polishing shoes here”之类更自然。

m-047.translation: I'm planning to start learning Python programming with absolutely zero foundation. Where would be a good place to begin?

m-043.translation: I can't even, your nickname for me is making me laugh so hard, that's brutal.

errors.note: 原文“你这备注名”指对方给说话人起的备注名，但未明确是“for me”，译文添加了“for me”，可能改变所指对象。
“太损了”指备注名很刻薄/毒舌，译作“brutal”基本可接受，但略偏“残酷”，语气稍有偏差。

m-049.translation: As a new content creator, I've noticed that my video views are decent, but the comment section is always quiet.

m-046.translation: If you've got fleas on you, go take a shower. You've made my phone smell nasty.

errors.note: “把我手机整的骚哄的”意思是说话人自己的手机被弄得有跳蚤的臭味，译文“You've made my phone smell nasty”却把责任归到对方身上，改变了原意。

errors.span: You've made my phone smell nasty.
errors.note: 原文是抱怨自己的手机被弄得有臭味，并非指责对方弄臭了手机，主语和施事关系译错。

m-050.translation: Remember, you don't need much equipment at the beginning—the key is to shoot more and practice more.

m-051.translation: Quick, let me pinch myself to see if I'm dreaming.

m-053.translation: I've been under a lot of work pressure lately and often get so anxious that I can't sleep. Are there any ways to relieve it?

m-055.translation: During a dorm inspection for contraband, a condom fell out from under my roommate's pillow.

m-052.translation: You're already crying from anxiety—this is even colder than the cold palace.

errors.note: “急哭”是夸张口语，意为“急得要哭/急得不行”，并非真的在哭；译成“already crying from anxiety”变成了字面意义的哭泣，意思有明显偏差。

errors.span: this is even colder than the cold palace
errors.note: “冷宫”直译为“cold palace”生硬，英语观众难以理解其“失宠被冷落之地”的文化含义，宜意译或加注。

m-054.translation: If it's all about luck, why do we still need to look at the equipment?

errors.span: why do we still need to look at the equipment?
errors.note: “看装备”指查看/考虑装备，译文“look at the equipment”字面化，且“we still need to”把反问语气改成必要性陈述，意思有偏差。

errors.span: why do we still need to look at the equipment?
errors.note: 字幕口语中“look at the equipment”生硬，不够自然。

m-057.translation: My mom said she wants to introduce me to a blind date.

errors.span: introduce me to a blind date
errors.note: “介绍相亲对象”指介绍一个潜在的相亲人选，而“introduce me to a blind date”暗示介绍给一个已经是相亲对象的人，意思有偏差。
“家人们”是网络直播/视频中对观众的口语称呼，译成“Family”生硬且不符合英语字幕习惯，宜用“Guys/Everyone”等。
“还死着”是夸张口语（如“我快死了/我还瘫着”），直译为“still dead”字面意思偏差，语气也不自然。

m-058.translation: I'll deal with you when I get back to the country.

errors.note: 漏译“再更新”，原文含“下次更新/再联系时”的意思，译文未体现。

errors.span: I'll deal with you when I get back to the country.
errors.note: “get back to the country”较生硬，口语字幕更自然说法是“when I get back”或“when I'm back in the country”。

m-059.translation: Seeing a video of a delivery rider delivering food in the rain.

m-060.translation: The exam answers are on page 50 of the textbook.

m-061.translation: What should we do, sisters, if we're swooning over this move?

m-066.translation: I can't understand the English listening exam at all.

m-062.translation: My feed is full of people posting 666, and it's making my scalp tingle.

errors.note: “六百六十六”是中文网络用语，指“666”（厉害/牛），直接保留数字“666”在英文中会被理解为恶魔数字或毫无意义，丢失了原意。
“头皮发麻”是习语，表示尴尬/不适/震惊，直译“scalp tingle”在英文中不自然，读者难以理解其引申义。

m-065.translation: There's a guy in the next class who strikes a brooding pose in front of the mirror after class and says he's the lead in some XXX drama.

m-064.translation: I'm going to attend the teacher qualification certificate interview next week. Are there any special points to pay attention to in the trial lecture segment?

errors.note: “试讲”在教师资格证面试语境下通常译为 “mock teaching” 或 “demo lesson”，“trial lecture” 不够准确、不够地道。

errors.span: special points to pay attention to
errors.note: 表达冗长生硬，字幕口语中更自然的是 “anything special to watch out for” 或 “any special things to note”。

m-070.translation: I just shared a meme I'd been saving for a year in the group chat, and it fell flat.

m-069.translation: What does this Moments post from my partner mean?

m-072.translation: I can't take it anymore, this is way too intense.

m-068.translation: I can't take it anymore, ahhh, listening to this is making my brain matter freeze.

errors.note: 把中文语气词“啊啊啊”直译成英文拟声词，字幕口语中显得生硬不自然。
“脑浆都要凝固了”是夸张比喻，直译为 brain matter freeze 略显字面化，但意思基本可理解。

m-074.translation: Ideally something that's great for taking photos and checking in.

m-071.translation: You're already crying from anxiety, reply right away, reply right away.

errors.note: “急哭”是夸张口语，意为“急得要哭/非常着急”，译成“crying from anxiety”变成真的在哭，语义偏差明显。

errors.span: reply right away, reply right away
errors.note: 重复“reply right away”生硬，不像字幕口语，可用“answer me”等更自然的催促表达。

m-067.translation: I can't even, I'm dying laughing, this impression is way too spot-on, it's basically a perfect replica of the original, 666, not even pretending anymore, this drama queen is the real deal.

errors.note: “666”是中文网络用语（表示厉害/牛），直接保留数字对英文观众毫无意义，应意译为类似“insane”或“next level”。

errors.span: this drama queen is the real deal
errors.note: “戏精本精”指此人本身就是戏精/爱演，译成“the real deal”略有偏差，但大意可接受。

errors.span: I can't even, I'm dying laughing, this impression is way too spot-on, it's basically a perfect replica of the original, 666, not even pretending anymore, this drama queen is the real deal.
errors.note: 整句用逗号串成流水句，缺少句号或分句，作为字幕读起来不够自然。

m-073.translation: Li Zongheng portrays a story about a father-in-law who enjoys playing pranks, showcasing the amusing Spring Festival incidents of this generation of young people starting to take charge.

errors.note: “这届年轻人”是网络流行语，指当代年轻人，译为“this generation of young people”略偏字面，但意思基本可接受。

errors.span: showcasing the amusing Spring Festival incidents of this generation of young people starting to take charge
errors.note: 长串名词修饰结构生硬，作为字幕不够口语化、不易读。

m-076.translation: You need to prepare: 200g cake flour, 100g butter, 60g powdered sugar, 1 egg.

m-078.translation: I'm already halfway done, I've written 50 slides for the PPT, and now you're telling me it might need to be scrapped and started over?

m-077.translation: Oh my god, this flavor is absolutely amazing.

errors.note: “我勒个豆”是网络化、俏皮的口语感叹，译成“Oh my god”偏直白、宗教化，语气不够贴合原文的轻松调侃感。
“太顶了”是网络俚语，表示“非常棒/很上头”，译成“absolutely amazing”意思对但偏书面、平淡，缺少原文的俚语味。

m-079.translation: How's the new character from this gacha?

m-075.translation: The meme "I want to check the cards" originates from a classic line in Stephen Chow's movie God of Gamblers III: Back to Shanghai.

errors.span: God of Gamblers III: Back to Shanghai
errors.note: 周星驰的《赌神》系列应为《赌侠》(God of Gamblers II)，而 God of Gamblers III: Back to Shanghai 是另一部影片，片名错误会误导观众。
原文“法国赌神”被漏译，译文中未体现这一关键信息。
原文“可以可以”只是重复“可以”，表示“还行/可以”，译文却译成“that works”，凭空添加了“能起作用”的意思，属于误译。

m-087.translation: I just finished writing a business plan. Take a look and see what you think.

m-084.translation: Recommend doing 20 targeted practice questions every day, and you'll see progress within a month.

m-081.translation: Has no one noticed how smart she is? She used abstract content to build her account and succeeded, then switched to a beauty-focused style to create a big contrast for her fans.

errors.note: “抽象”在此指抽象/荒诞风格的梗或内容，译作“abstract content”略显字面，但基本可理解。

errors.span: create a big contrast for her fans
errors.note: “给粉丝大反差”是口语化表达，译成“create a big contrast for her fans”偏生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-082.translation: I really stayed to watch the Spring Festival Gala. This program is just too wonderful!

errors.note: 原文“留在了春晚看”意为“一直留在（电视机前）看春晚”，译文“stayed to watch”弱化了“一直/舍不得离开”的语气，且“真是”的强调意味丢失。

errors.span: I really stayed to watch the Spring Festival Gala.
errors.note: 字幕口语中“stayed to watch”略显生硬，未体现原文“一直守着看”的自然口语感。

m-086.translation: The teammate is 0-10 and still bossing everyone around like crazy.

m-085.translation: She'll probably laugh when she sees this meme, right?

m-083.translation: I can't even, this is way too handsome!

errors.note: “I can't even”是网络流行语，与原文“我不行了”的感叹语气不完全对应，略显生硬。
“handsome”通常指人外貌英俊，而原文“帅”在此语境更偏向“酷/帅气”，语义略有偏差。

m-088.translation: I've been thinking about starting yoga at home recently, but I have absolutely no foundation and don't know where to begin.

m-089.translation: I'm begging you, hold it in, don't let the boss find out.

m-090.translation: How can you see through a cheater when playing cards?

m-092.translation: What challenge do you want to see next? Leave a comment in the comments section.

errors.span: Leave a comment in the comments section.
errors.note: “comment”与“comments section”重复冗余，字幕口语中更自然简洁的说法是“Leave a comment below”或“Comment below”。

m-091.translation: Only things so abstract that people can't understand them count as challenges.

m-093.translation: Are you sick? I can't take it anymore.

errors.note: “有病吧”是口语化的吐槽/骂人语，意为“你有毛病吧/你疯了吧”，译成询问对方是否生病的“Are you sick?”属于误译，改变了原意。

errors.span: Are you sick? I can't take it anymore.
errors.note: 两句被拆成独立问句和陈述句，语气生硬，不像字幕口语中连贯的吐槽语气。

m-095.translation: This joke is so funny it should be on CCTV.

m-094.translation: Hahaha I can't even, your description is way too funny.

errors.note: “六百六十六”是网络用语“666”（表示厉害、牛），直译为数字六百六十六丢失了原意，观众会误解为字面数字。

m-099.translation: You understand what "workplace warmth" means now, right?

m-098.translation: Why are you so averse to internet slang?

m-101.translation: This is the first time I've felt so directly how strong my internet addiction is.

m-103.translation: If it weren't for this damn job tying me down every day, I'd buy a plane ticket right now and fly to Xi'an to settle the score with you!

m-100.translation: I recommend downloading the Keep or Xunji app and following the free courses to work out—it's safe and systematic.

m-102.translation: Did you know that Logger Vick's voice actor is actually a top-tier singer?

m-104.translation: What memes are post-00s playing with now?

errors.note: “玩梗”指使用/传播网络梗，不是“play with memes”（把梗当玩具玩），动词搭配误译导致意思偏差。
“00后”英文常用 the post-2000s generation / Gen Z，post-00s 不够规范但可理解。

m-107.translation: I rushed down to confront them, but got so worked up that I bit my tongue. Now it hurts so much that tears are streaming down my face.

m-105.translation: You didn't say that earlier—I wasted so much time trying to figure out the character relationships.

errors.note: “我去不早说”是口语化的抱怨/惊讶，译文偏中性陈述，语气略弱，但意思无误。

m-108.translation: I'm begging you, please let our team go.

m-110.translation: You can set up a basic system within a budget of 2,000. Remember to leave space for power outlets and ensure network coverage.

errors.note: 原文“2000内”指2000元人民币以内，译文未标明货币单位，英文读者可能误以为是美元或其他货币，金额含义偏差明显。

m-109.translation: Ha, it's fine. I'm watching the movie you mentioned at the New Year's Eve party.

errors.span: at the New Year's Eve party
errors.note: 原文“跨年晚会”是说话人所在/观看的场合，译文却把“看电影”的地点误挂到跨年晚会上，意思变成“在跨年晚会上看电影”，与原文“我在跨年晚会这边看你说的电影”不符。

m-112.translation: Are tutorials these days really this watered down?

m-114.translation: My mom said if I don't find a partner soon, I shouldn't bother coming home.

m-116.translation: I ate the last piece of cake.

m-115.translation: Keep your resume to one page, use a clean layout, and absolutely avoid typos.

m-113.translation: Graduate school entrance exam preparation has hit a bottleneck period. I feel anxious every day and can't focus on studying. How should I adjust my mindset and improve efficiency?

m-117.translation: Alright, when I return to the country, I'll officiate your wedding.

errors.note: “证婚”指作为证婚人见证婚礼，并非主持婚礼，officiate 意为主持仪式，意思有偏差。

m-118.translation: Watching the Spring Festival Gala, huh? Then I'll just fast-forward you straight to New Year's Eve.

m-119.translation: Too abstract—an overview of the mental state of contemporary young people.

errors.span: Too abstract—an overview of the mental state of contemporary young people.
errors.note: “Too abstract”作为网络流行语（意为“太离谱/太魔幻”）直译后英文读者难以领会其调侃语气，且整句偏书面、不够口语化，不太像字幕口语。

m-121.translation: I can't take it anymore, this kid has gone crazy.

m-124.translation: I stayed up late last night and I'm so sleepy.

m-123.translation: For traveling with parents, it is recommended to choose a leisure city with convenient transportation and well-developed facilities.

m-122.translation: This is the first time I've seen such a luxurious villa.

m-126.translation: What's going on when someone suddenly bursts out laughing at an anatomy diagram?

m-120.translation: I've been wanting to learn how to make bread recently, but I have no foundation at all. Where should I start to get started?

errors.span: I have no foundation at all
errors.note: “no foundation”是中文“没基础”的直译，英语中更自然的说法是“no experience”或“starting from scratch”。

errors.span: Where should I start to get started?
errors.note: “start to get started”语义重复、不通顺，应改为“Where should I start?”或“How should I get started?”。

m-125.translation: This is Abstract Bro, not like B Bro who quietly does his problems.

errors.note: “抽象哥”是网络绰号，直译成 Abstract Bro 生硬，观众难以理解其“行为抽象/离谱”的含义。
“b哥”作为绰号直译为 B Bro，不够自然，且与“抽象哥”的译法风格不一致。
“安静做题”译成 quietly does his problems 偏生硬，不像字幕口语，且 problems 指代不清（应为练习题）。

m-128.translation: The boss said the bonus will be doubled this month.

m-130.translation: That metaphor is way too abstract, isn't it?

m-131.translation: I can't take it anymore. The sun must be rising from the west.

errors.span: The sun must be rising from the west.
errors.note: “太阳打西边出来了”是表示惊讶的习语，直译成“太阳从西边升起”显得生硬，不像自然的英文字幕口语。

m-129.translation: I'm begging you, hold it in, don't let them think you're a psycho.

m-127.translation: Why do you care so much about what others say about six hundred sixty-six?

errors.note: “六百六十六”是中文网络用语（谐音“溜溜溜”，意为厉害/牛），直译成数字会丢失原意，观众无法理解。

m-132.translation: I wish you'd told me earlier—I'm running home right now to change my clothes.

m-133.translation: For food, just go around the wet market—it's cheap and authentic.

m-134.translation: My partner said they want to take a one-month break with me.

m-135.translation: So what? Got conquered by their looks, huh?

errors.span: Got conquered by their looks, huh?
errors.note: “Got conquered by their looks”是直译，英语口语中不自然，更地道的说法如“So you're won over by their looks?”。

m-136.translation: If the area is large, Mesh distributed routing is the best solution. Although it is more expensive, it provides seamless coverage throughout the entire house.

m-137.translation: The power of six wallets, with per capita savings of one million.

errors.span: with per capita savings of one million
errors.note: “人均存款百万”是夸张/宣传性说法，译文用“with per capita savings of one million”将其表述为事实性数据，语气和含义有偏差。

errors.span: The power of six wallets, with per capita savings of one million.
errors.note: 字幕口语化不足，逗号连接的两个短语略显生硬，不像自然的英文字幕表达。

m-138.translation: No way, I'm going to lie flat at home.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不相处/不谈恋爱”，译成“No way”改变了意思，变成拒绝或惊讶。
“躺平”直译为“lie flat”生硬，英语观众不易理解其“放弃内卷、低欲望生活”的含义，宜用“lie flat”加引号或意译。

m-139.translation: The pair of shoes I just managed to grab is actually a pre-sale.

errors.span: The pair of shoes I just managed to grab
errors.note: 原文“刚刚抢到的”是名词性结构（“我刚抢到的那双鞋”），译文添加了第一人称主语“I”，改变了主语，属于增译/误译。
“预售”指预售商品/预售状态，用“a pre-sale”作表语略显生硬，宜用“a pre-order”或“a pre-sale item”。

m-141.translation: Please, I really want to rank up. I'm begging you, don't leave.

m-142.translation: My mom insists on setting me up on a blind date.

m-143.translation: This exam is too difficult, I have no idea how to do it at all.

m-140.translation: Take a look at the hellish joke I just learned.

errors.note: “地狱笑话”是网络用语，指以他人苦难或禁忌话题为笑点的黑色幽默，译成“hellish joke”会被理解为“糟糕/可怕的玩笑”，丢失了“黑色幽默/冒犯性幽默”的核心含义。
字幕口语中“看看”更自然的说法是“Check out”或“Look at”，此处略显生硬。

m-146.translation: I can't even, hahaha, he's so talented.

m-148.translation: That's so abstract, it reminds me of my classmate. In elementary school, they exclaimed that I was so white and asked if I was Caucasian.

m-145.translation: You're clearly still not thinking straight. A 996 corporate drone is only fit to lie around at home like a couch potato. The delivery guy is my best buddy.

errors.span: lie around at home like a couch potato
errors.note: “葛优躺”是特定的网络梗（慵懒瘫躺姿势），译成泛化的 couch potato 丢失了文化专有含义，但大意可理解。

errors.span: The delivery guy is my best buddy
errors.note: “外卖小哥”带亲昵口语色彩，best buddy 略显夸张且偏儿童化，语气不够贴合字幕口语。

m-144.translation: I recommend the figure-specific section of Huatu Module Treasure Book; the explanations are very systematic.

errors.note: “图形专项”指图形推理/图形题专项，译成“figure-specific section”易被理解为“人物/插图专项”，意思偏差。
书名《华图模块宝典》宜用规范译名或音译加书名号处理，此处直译生硬且不统一。

m-149.translation: My boss suddenly asked me to go on a business trip abroad.

m-150.translation: My dad said back then all it took to win my mom over was one meal.

m-147.translation: But I think it's very sacred, that's a family heirloom-level thing!

errors.note: “family heirloom-level thing”生硬直译，字幕口语中更自然说法如“that's basically a family heirloom”
